subject: Exchange plan for eval samples & prompt pack — MAP draft and guardrails
messages:
From: Lucy Park <lucy.park@brightretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@brightretail.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jul 2025 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Evaluation sample exchange — first pass

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — team was impressed. We'd like to move forward with a short mutual action plan (MAP) to provision a small eval sandbox and exchange sample testcases + prompt packs so our ML team can run acceptance tests. Key constraints from our side:

- Files must be ephemeral (not used for model training or derivative datasets) and be destroyed after the pilot window.
- No retention beyond the agreed TTL; BrightRetail legal will require a destruction certificate.
- Some testcases contain PII and need minimal redaction before transfer.

I attached a first-pass prompt pack and a small sample corpus (promptpack_v1.zip, sample-corpus-10k.csv) to illustrate typical content.

Can you propose a MAP with milestones, access window, and technical guardrails (tokens, IP access)? Procurement will need a clear close timeline and a sample MPA clause for non-training use.

Proposed high-level run: 2-week sandbox, 8-week evaluation, then final acceptance. But willing to discuss.

Thanks,
Lucy Park
Head of Data Science, BrightRetail

Attachments: promptpack_v1.zip (zip), sample-corpus-10k.csv (csv)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Park <lucy.park@brightretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jul 2025 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evaluation sample exchange — first pass

Hi Lucy — great to hear, and really appreciate the constraints up front.

High level response / next steps:

1) MAP: we can draft a concise MAP (milestones: sample handoff -> sandbox access -> acceptance tests -> signature) and attach it for review.
2) Sandbox: Redwood can provide an ephemeral sandbox with time-limited API keys and an isolated project. Default token TTL we propose is 90 days with immediate revocation on request.
3) Usage constraints: we will include a non-training clause in the MAP/MPA and provide a destruction certificate when the sandbox is torn down. We will also support alternate retention TTLs if you need shorter windows.
4) Redaction: we can help with on-transfer redaction guidance; if you prefer to deliver already redacted samples, we'll accept them as-is.

Marissa is looping in a MAP draft and a Google Drive link with proposed language. Lauren — I'd like you to confirm billing/discount cadence for this pilot and whether it should be a no-charge POC or capped-credit pilot.

Can you confirm the list of must-redact fields and whether procurement needs us to upload SOC2 evidence?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Park <lucy.park@brightretail.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jul 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + suggested guardrails (drive link)

Hi all — attaching a short MAP draft (attached as MAP-draft.pdf and also on Drive) that maps milestones and responsibilities. Key bullets from the draft:

- Week 0: Exchange sanitized sample corpus and prompt pack (we'll accept a redacted CSV or S3 share).
- Week 1: Redwood provisions ephemeral sandbox; engineering contact validates ingestion.
- Week 2–3: BrightRetail runs acceptance tests and shares result matrix.
- Week 4: Joint review; acceptance or remediation plan.

Guardrails we included in the draft:
- Non-training covenant (data, prompts, testcases explicitly excluded from training and model updates).
- Per-request logging (audit trail for each sample access).
- Ephemeral keys + scheduled revocation.
- Encrypted-at-rest and in-flight; access limited to named engineers.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-MAP-draft

Marissa — Notes on procurement items you should expect: a short MPA clause, destruction certificate template, and evidence of SOC2 controls.

Attachments: MAP-draft.pdf (pdf)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Lucy Park <lucy.park@brightretail.com>
Date: Sat, 05 Jul 2025 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + suggested guardrails (technical clarifications)

On Thu, Jul 3, 2025 at 11:20 AM Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> (Drive link and draft attached)

Hi Lucy / team — quick tech notes to confirm we can meet the guardrails in the draft:

- Sandbox provisioning: we will create an isolated project with its own model endpoint and S3-backed ephemeral storage. Ingestion can be via S3 presigned URL or secure Drive transfer.
- Token lifecycle: default ephemeral API keys expire in 90 days; we can shorten to 30 days upon request and provide revocation confirmation.
- Non-training enforcement: Redwood will set "no-train" flags on the ingestion pipeline; we also support watermarking testcases on request to detect accidental reuse.
- PII handling: we recommend pre-transfer hashing of identifiers and a minimal redaction checklist; if you want Redwood to do sanitization we can run a scoped redaction job (time & cost estimate in separate email).
- Audit & destruction: when the sandbox is torn down we will issue a destruction certificate (signed PDF) listing artifacts destroyed.

Technical ask for BrightRetail: please confirm the exact S3 prefix or Drive folder we should pull from and an engineer point-of-contact for ingest validation.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Engineer, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Lucy Park <lucy.park@brightretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Jul 2025 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Finalize MAP & next steps (DocuSign + meeting)

Lucy — thanks for the fast responses and clarifications. To summarize and close the loop:

- Agreed MAP milestones: sample handoff (Day 0), sandbox provision (Day 1–2), acceptance window (Days 7–21), joint review (Day 28), sign-off and destruction certificate (Day 35).
- Usage constraints: non-training covenant included; Redwood to set no-train flag and provide destruction certificate on teardown.
- Token TTL: default 90 days; BrightRetail requested 30-day TTL for the pilot — we will set to 30 days and confirm revocation on demand.
- PII: BrightRetail will deliver pre-redacted CSV; if you prefer, Redwood can run a redaction job (quote separate).
- Procurement asks: we will surface SOC2 evidence (redwood.com/soc2) and attach the MAP as a short appendix to the MPA.

Next steps:
1) Lucy — please confirm S3 prefix or upload to the Drive link and name an engineering contact for ingest validation.
2) Marissa — finalise MAP (attached MAP-final.pdf) and send DocuSign (link below).
3) Lauren — confirm pilot billing terms (credit vs trial).

DocuSign (MAP): https://www.docusign.com/trace/BR-2025-349
Drive (draft + final): https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link-MAP-draft

If that all looks good I suggest a 30-minute sync on 2025-07-15 to kick off. Please reply with any last items and we'll get DocuSign out the same day.

Best regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-final.pdf (pdf)
